title: Passive Voice: is/are + Past Participle
grammarNote:
Пассивный залог (Passive Voice) — используется когда важно ЧТО происходит, а не КТО делает. В русском: "был построен", "создаётся", "будет решено".

📌 Когда используем пассив:
① Неизвестен деятель: "The window was broken."
② Деятель неважен: "English is taught all over the world."
③ Официальный стиль: "The experiment was conducted in 2023."

🔧 Образование: TO BE + PAST PARTICIPLE

Present Simple: am/is/are + PP
"English IS spoken here." · "These cars ARE made in Germany."

Past Simple: was/were + PP
"The castle WAS built in 1450." · "They WERE told the news."

Present Perfect: has/have been + PP
"The report HAS BEEN sent." · "New laws HAVE BEEN introduced."

Future: will be + PP
"The results WILL BE published tomorrow."

📍 Добавить деятеля → BY + noun:
"The novel was written by Tolstoy."

grammarTip:
Активный vs Пассивный залог:

АКТИВНЫЙ → фокус на том, КТО делает:
"Scientists discovered a new planet." (ученые важны)

ПАССИВНЫЙ → фокус на том, ЧТО происходит:
"A new planet was discovered." (планета важнее)

💡 Когда выбирать пассив:
✅ Деятель неизвестен: "My car was stolen."
✅ Деятель очевиден: "The President was elected."
✅ Деятель неважен: "English is spoken in 67 countries."
✅ Научный стиль: "The experiment was repeated three times."

🔧 Active → Passive:
"They built this bridge in 1920." → "This bridge was built in 1920."

exercises.text: Change to passive: "Scientists study climate change."
opts: Climate change is studied by scientists.
exercises.correct: Climate change is studied by scientists.
exercises.hint: "Climate change" = new subject; "is studied" = passive; "by scientists" = agent.

exercises.text: "Cars is produced in factories" is correct.
exercises.hint: "Cars" is plural → "Cars are produced in factories."

exercises.text: Exams ___ (take) at the end of each semester.
Passive with "by": "The event ___ organised ___ the Eco Club."
exercises.hint: "event" = singular → is; agent = "by the Eco Club".

exercises.text: Change to passive: "The government funds the programme."
opts: The programme is funded by the government.
The government is funded by the programme.
The programme fund by the government.
exercises.correct: The programme is funded by the government.
exercises.hint: "The programme" = new subject; "is funded" = passive; "by the government" = agent.

exercises.instruction: Choose the best use of passive.
exercises.text: When is passive voice most appropriate?
opts: When the doer is obvious, unknown, or unimportant
exercises.correct: When the doer is obvious, unknown, or unimportant
exercises.hint: Passive focuses on the action/result, not on who does it.

exercises.text: "Beshbarmak is eaten at celebrations" is a correct passive sentence.

questions.hint: Passive: is/are + past participle (+ by + agent).

questions.text: Change to passive: "People speak English here."
"The cars are produce in Japan" is correct.
questions.hint: Must use past participle: "The cars are produced in Japan."

questions.text: In "Events are organised by the club," "by the club" tells us:
questions.hint: "by + agent" in passive = who performs the action.

opts: The doer is the most important part
The result or action is more important than the doer
We are describing a future action
questions.correct: The result or action is more important than the doer
questions.hint: We use passive when the focus is on WHAT happened, not WHO did it.
"is taken" = passive form. This is a passive question.
